title: OrderCancelled v2
description: The `message` body of the MassTransit envelope published on the order-cancelled-v2 exchange. The order is final (specs 002, 003, 006). Replaces v1 (spec 016, ADR 0010): the reason may be StaffRequested.

reason.description: Why the order was cancelled. StaffRequested: our support team cancelled it at the customer's request (spec 016). A new reason needs a new version of this event (constitution IV, spec 014).

detail.description: Human-readable detail, e.g. which items were short.
